Rifle Combat Styles

Choose Rifle for shots that reward careful timing or suppress enemy evasion and movement.

Rifle - Marksman

Marksman rewards pauses between attacks and includes a defense-piercing shot in a line.

Rifle - Suppression

Suppression builds effects that reduce enemy evasion and includes attacks that hinder movement.
